Title:Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone J.K. Rowling 1997
Edition:Softcover
Publisher:1997
Condition:Used - Very Good
Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone J.K. Rowling 1997. Delve into the enchanting world of witchcraft and wizardry with J.K. Rowling's classic 'Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone'. Published in 1997 by Bloomsbury Publishing, this hardback edition is a treasure for any young reader between 9 and 11 years. The book spans 224 pages and measures 198mm in height and 129mm in width, making it a substantial yet comfortable read. This particular copy, printed in the United Kingdom, boasts the distinguished accolades of the Whitaker Platinum Book Award 2001 and the Smarties Book Prize Gold Award 1997, amongst others. The ISBN-10 is 0747532699 and the ISBN-13 is 9780747532699. Whether for personal enjoyment or as an addition to a collection, this book is sure to captivate and inspire.
